# 5.6.2024 Commission Agenda

Posted on [May 3, 2024](https://www.valleycity.us/2024/05/03/commission-agenda-13 "10:06 am")May 3, 2024 by [Judi Hintz](https://www.valleycity.us/author/jhintz "View all posts by Judi Hintz")

# City Commission Meeting Valley City, North Dakota

## Monday, May 6, 2024 5:00 PM

The City Commission Meeting will begin on Monday, May 6, 2024, at 5:00 PM CT, at the City Commission Chambers, 254 2nd Avenue NE, Valley City, ND.

The meeting is also available to view online [https://us06web.zoom.us/j/84721559565](https://us06web.zoom.us/j/84721559565) or listen by calling (1 346 248 7799) Webinar ID: 847 2155 9565.

### Next Resolution No. 2447            Next Ordinance No. 1155

### Call To Order

### Roll Call

### Pledge of Allegiance (please stand)

### Approval of Agenda

(Roll Call Vote needed when changes made to the Agenda)

### Approval of Minutes

Approve Minutes from the April 16, 2024, Commission Meeting.

### Approval of Consent Agenda

01. Approve Monthly Reports from the Fire Chief, Electrical Superintendent, Building Inspector Finance Director and Municipal Judge.
02. Approve hearing on dangerous building located at 304 3rd St. SE. *(City Attorney Martineck)*
03. Approve Special Event Application May – September 2024 Indoor &amp; Outdoor at Straus Mall, A Martinson. *(Finance Director Klein)*
04. Approve Block Off the Street request from Soap Box Derby for 6.1.24.  *(Finance Director Klein)*
05. Approve Block Off the Street request Valley City Area Chamber of Commerce for 6.15.24 for Community Days.  *(Finance Director Klein)*
06. Approve Block Off the Street request from Valley City Barnes County Development Corporation for 6.13, 7.11, 8.8 &amp; 9.12, 2024 for Summer Nights on Central.  *(Finance Director Klein)*
07. Approve the Application for a Parade for the Valley City Area Chamber of Commerce on 6.15.2024 starting at 10AM. *(Finance Director Klein)*
08. Approve Raffle Permits for:
09. Bridge City Cruisers on 6.14.2024 at Stoudt/Miller
10. Bridge City Cruisers on 6.15.2024 at the Car Show on Main &amp; Central
11. Red Knights Motorcycle Club ND 1 on 9.15.2024 at the VC Eagles

    1. Dollar General Store #17856

### Public Comments

Attorney General’s “A Citizen’s Guide to North Dakota Open Records &amp; Open Meetings Laws” \**A member of the public does not have the right to speak to the governing body at an open meeting.  The public is only entitled to see and hear what happens at a meeting, and to record or broadcast those observations.*

- No personal attacks to persons present or not
- No inflammatory language used during time that you have the platform
- 5-minute maximum or as directed by the chair
- Thank you for participating in City Government.
